svg.aria-label: Habits: Green or it doesn't merge — fmt, vet, race tests, lint and govulncheck on every push; No secrets in git — gitleaks checks each commit before it leaves the laptop; Setup as code — one command rebuilds my Mac, dot doctor checks it; Small, plain services — cmd/ and internal/, plain net/http when it's enough
